name: 72076 · Jacksonville, AR
findings: ZIP 72076 (Jacksonville) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72076 (Jacksonville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 72076 (Jacksonville) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 37% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
